title_zh: 健康气流、热暴露与水风险验证计划
purpose: 把六项当前 unknown 指标转化为可由专业团队执行、校准和复核的证据合同；本文件不提供海淀现场测量、CFD 结果、健康结论或审批依据。

cultural_boundary.permitted_use: 京张沿线的空间记忆、景观叙事和文化感知词汇
prohibited_inference: 空气质量或污染稀释证明
水文规律、排水能力或工程安全结论
审批、实施或专业责任替代
cultural_boundary.reporting_rule: 所有健康气流判断必须分别报告风舒适、污染滞留、热暴露、遮阴、蓝绿可达和水风险；不得汇总成风水健康分。

global_entry_requirements: official boundary or a versioned surveyed geometry package; provisional geometry must remain labelled
versioned three-dimensional buildings, tree canopy, screens, pavements, water and activity layers
seasonal wind and heat case table with boundary-condition provenance
field protocol, instrument calibration records, timestamps, locations and missing-data log
reproducible formulas, model settings, uncertainty/error report and responsible professional sign-off

routes.role: request station metadata and climate-normal fields through the Beijing public-data platform
routes.boundary: registered-user access is required; a catalogue record is not a local measurement

routes.role: coordinate a lawful request for relevant monitoring/forecast context and identify responsible data owners
routes.boundary: the reported 1+21+65+100 network does not prove conditions inside any Jing-Zhang route

routes.role: use the station report to define a nearby monitoring-context dependency
routes.boundary: nearby station context cannot replace key-area anemometer observations or CFD calibration

official_input_routes.rule: Until a lawful, versioned dataset is obtained and its station-to-site relevance is reviewed, all six local metrics remain unknown.

required_for_transition: all gate-specific required evidence is present
simulation and field observations are compared on the same geometry/version
calibration error and exclusions are reported
the responsible professional accepts the method and limitations
state_transition.otherwise: remain unknown; a design_target is not a measured baseline

gates.question_zh: 行人层是否同时避免危险强风、风墙加速和大面积静风？
required_inputs: three key-area geometries plus representative connecting routes
seasonal prevailing-wind cases and calm/storm sensitivity cases
leaf-on and leaf-off tree/canopy states
pedestrian-level CFD setup and field anemometer observations
gates.method: Run professionally reviewed pedestrian-level simulations, then compare sampled wind speed/direction at the same locations and times; report each season, wind case and user activity condition separately.
do_not_claim: no local comfort percentage before calibration

gates.question_zh: 交通、施工、活动和街谷界面是否形成可识别的污染滞留热点？
required_inputs: emission-source inventory and activity schedule
background PM2.5 and co-located meteorological observations
wind boundary conditions and street-canyon geometry
air-age or another professionally accepted ventilation-effectiveness method
gates.method: Map candidate sources first, then combine observed PM2.5 trends with calibrated dispersion/air-age analysis; report detection limits, missing periods and source attribution uncertainty.
do_not_claim: no health benefit from a visual corridor
no pollutant reduction without source and background data

gates.question_zh: 高温时段的热暴露是否被树冠、廊架、材料和可停留节点共同缓解？
required_inputs: seasonal and time-of-day solar/tree-canopy model
surface and air-temperature observations
MRT or equivalent professionally accepted thermal measurements
accompanied route tests with older, disabled and heat-sensitive users
gates.method: Compare exposed and shaded route segments across representative heat conditions; preserve group-specific discomfort and do not use tree count as a thermal-comfort proxy.
do_not_claim: no health outcome from green coverage
no current MRT value before measurement

gates.question_zh: 无障碍主链在高温时段是否有连续、可进入、可维护的遮阴和休息？
required_inputs: route network with slopes, crossings, obstacles and accessible entrances
leaf-on/leaf-off and seasonal shade coverage
water, rest, cooling and staffed fallback locations
paired route audits with maintenance and accessibility records
gates.method: Calculate route continuity only after field-confirming entrances, slopes, shade duration, rest points and maintenance; publish the weakest segment rather than only an area average.
do_not_claim: no accessible route from green polygon overlap alone
no target coverage presented as current coverage

gates.question_zh: 蓝绿空间是否真正可进入、连续、安全并由人使用，而不只是靠近路线？
required_inputs: official or surveyed entrances and route continuity
slope, surface, lighting, water-quality and safety observations
maintenance ownership and closure records
stratified user feedback and non-digital participation
gates.method: Intersect only verified accessible route segments with usable blue-green access points, then report seasonal closures, safety issues and group differences.
do_not_claim: no physical or mental-health benefit from proximity alone
no water-quality conclusion from a map layer

gates.question_zh: 暴雨、积水和超标行泄时，关键无障碍路线是否避开危险水深与流速并可回退？
required_inputs: surveyed DEM, drainage network, outfalls, soils and groundwater constraints
design-storm cases and two-dimensional surface-flow model
water depth/velocity thresholds approved by the responsible professionals
route closure, warning, maintenance and no-device fallback procedure
gates.method: Test ordinary and exceedance routes separately, validate low points after storm events and record when a route is closed or manually rerouted.
do_not_claim: no 聚水生财 or health inference
no drainage capacity from a rain-garden drawing

release_gate.before_design_freeze: All six gates must have a versioned input package, calibration or field record, uncertainty statement and named professional reviewer.
release_gate.when_evidence_is_missing: Keep the metric unknown, label the geometry provisional where applicable, and use manual/non-AI route and safety fallback.
